details: • GEN AI - RATE ANALYSIS (JUN	2024	-	FEB	2025)

details: Relevant	Activities	:

live	production	feed	for	comparison	using	camera.

logic	to	compute	homography	and	match	confidence	scores.

entry.text: Relevant	Activities	:
* Coordinated	with	MATE	engineers	to	understand	machine	workflow	and	automation	check-
points.	Defined	operational	parameters	for	acceptable	part	quality	using	visual	cues.
* Captured	and	labeled	reference	images	of	correctly	molded	parts	for	training	and	validation.Recorded
live	production	feed	for	comparison	using	camera.
* Implemented	ORB	(Oriented	FAST	and	Rotated	BRIEF)	feature	descriptors	for	key-point	extrac-
tion.	Tuned	image	preprocessing	pipeline	(grayscale	conversion,	thresholding,	denoising,	etc.).
* Developed	OpenCV-based	image	matching	logic	to	compare	live	feed	with	reference	image.Implemented
logic	to	compute	homography	and	match	confidence	scores.
* Performed	daily	tests	on	live	production	units	to	ensure	detection	reliability	under	varying	light-
ing	 and	 part	 conditions.Logged	 and	 debugged	 false	 positives/negatives	 in	 visual	 comparison
output.
* Fine-tuned	ORB	parameters	for	speed	and	accuracy	trade-off	in	embedded	hardware.	Optimized
pipeline	latency	to	keep	cycle	time	within	acceptable	bounds	(	milliseconds	delay).
* Maintained	 daily	 logs	 of	 testing	 results,	 false	 match	 cases,	 and	 improvements.	Created	 user
documentation	for	operators	to	understand	system	usage	and	behavior.
* Participated	 in	 daily	 stand-up	 or	 syncs	 with	 project	 team	 and	 MATE	 engineers.	Reviewed	 inte-
gration	feedback	from	the	shop	floor	and	revised	logic	accordingly.
• RARE ADENOID CANCER CLASSIFICATION using SVM (Sep	2023	-	Feb	2024)
◦ Biomedical	 Data	 |	 diagnose	 adenoid	 cancer	 in	 early	 stages	 |	 Visualization:	 pairplots,	 countplot,	 scat-
terplot,	 heatmap|	 Confusion	 Matrix	 |	 Model	 improvement:	 Feature	 scaling,	 Optimize	 C	 and	 Gamma
parameters	using	Grid	Search	|	Ensemble	methods.
